note: v504: A bank charge could be explained by a record that had ALREADY cleared on a previous month's statement. Auto-matches are never saved, so August's check knew nothing about what July matched, and any record dated in the last stretch of July was still a candidate — so one $150 expense could explain two different $150 charges in two different months, with both months reporting a clean pass and a transaction nobody recorded quietly absorbed. Now the two months settle it: exactly one keeps the record, and the other charge goes back to 'on the bank, not in your books' with a line saying which statement the record cleared on.
